title: Among customers who purchased product ID 5 at a unit price exceeding 25.00,
question: Among customers who purchased product ID 5 at a unit price exceeding 25.00, identify the client segment with the lowest percentage of individuals whose monthly gas consumption exceeded 50.0 in 2013.

prediction.sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE p.XCL_008 = 5
      AND t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017 > 25.00
),
customer_high AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.XCL_001,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_021 > 50.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_high
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.XCL_001 = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON qc.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY qc.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
),
segment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        CAST(SUM(had_high) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct
    FROM customer_high
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT segment
FROM segment_stats
ORDER BY pct ASC
LIMIT 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE p.XCL_008 = 5
      AND t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017 > 25.00
),
customer_high AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.XCL_001,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_021 > 50.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_high
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.XCL_001 = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON qc.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY qc.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
),
segment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        CAST(SUM(had_high) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct
    FROM customer_high
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT segment
FROM segment_stats
ORDER BY pct ASC
LIMIT 1

WITH qualifying_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT c.XCL_001
    FROM customers AS c
    INNER JOIN transactions_1k AS t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
    INNER JOIN products AS p ON t.XCL_016 = p.XCL_008
    WHERE p.XCL_008 = 5
      AND t.XCL_018 / t.XCL_017 > 25.00
),
customer_high AS (
    SELECT 
        qc.XCL_001,
        c.XCL_002 AS segment,
        MAX(CASE WHEN ym.XCL_021 > 50.0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS had_high
    FROM qualifying_customers AS qc
    INNER JOIN customers AS c ON qc.XCL_001 = c.XCL_001
    INNER JOIN yearmonth AS ym ON qc.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
    WHERE ym.XCL_020 BETWEEN '201301' AND '201312'
    GROUP BY qc.XCL_001, c.XCL_002
),
segment_stats AS (
    SELECT 
        segment,
        CAST(SUM(had_high) AS REAL) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS pct
    FROM customer_high
    GROUP BY segment
)
SELECT segment
FROM segment_stats
ORDER BY pct ASC
LIMIT 1

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT 
    c.XCL_003 AS client_segment
FROM 
    customers c
JOIN 
    transactions_1k t ON c.XCL_001 = t.XCL_013
JOIN 
    yearmonth ym ON c.XCL_001 = ym.XCL_019
WHERE 
    t.XCL_015 = 5 
    AND t.XCL_018 > 25.00
    AND ym.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
GROUP BY 
    c.XCL_003
ORDER BY 
    (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(*) 
        FROM 
            customers c2
        JOIN 
            transactions_1k t2 ON c2.XCL_001 = t2.XCL_013
        JOIN 
            yearmonth ym2 ON c2.XCL_001 = ym2.XCL_019
        WHERE 
            t2.XCL_015 = 5 
            AND t2.XCL_018 > 25.00
            AND ym2.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
            AND c2.XCL_003 = c.XCL_003
            AND ym2.XCL_021 > 50.0
    ) * 1.0 / (
        SELECT 
            COUNT(*) 
        FROM 
            customers c3
        JOIN 
            transactions_1k t3 ON c3.XCL_001 = t3.XCL_013
        JOIN 
            yearmonth ym3 ON c3.XCL_001 = ym3.XCL_019
        WHERE 
            t3.XCL_015 = 5 
            AND t3.XCL_018 > 25.00
            AND ym3.XCL_020 LIKE '2013%'
            AND c3.XCL_003 = c.XCL_003
    )
LIMIT 1
